revisionNote: Rev 2 corrects rev 1 after independent review. Rev 1 was accurate at NAME granularity but wrong at CALL-SITE granularity: it omitted a call site, misattributed two files, classified four sites by the throw at the call rather than by what the caller does with it, and did not record the moderation-column WRITE sites at all. Classifications below are per call site and were each read at the cited line.

onAbsentDefinitions.hard: the call throws AND a user-visible action fails
onAbsentDefinitions.degraded: the call throws but the caller completes the primary action and tells the user what was lost
onAbsentDefinitions.graceful: absence is detected and a working alternative path or empty state is used
onAbsentDefinitions.swallowed: the error is caught and discarded; no user-visible effect
onAbsentDefinitions.silent: no error check at all — the failure is invisible to code and user alike
onAbsentDefinitions.unreachable: cannot be called when its prerequisite contract is absent
onAbsentDefinitions.fail_closed: the capability is withheld with a warning and no permissive fallback
onAbsentDefinitions.optional_omitted: the call fails but successfully loaded primary content remains visible while optional dependent content is omitted

surfaces.phase04aNote: Phase 04A (2026-09-21): deleteFlag no longer calls the undeployed delete-flag Edge Function (P04-D01, accepted 2026-09-03 — do not deploy D1F4 merely to satisfy the client). It now issues a strict direct Data API DELETE authorized entirely by the live RLS below, requires a returned id (zero rows = FlagDeleteRefusedError, never a silent/false success), and best-effort cleans up every derivable photo object AFTER the row delete is confirmed. The 2026-09-04 deployed-contract.v1.json capture independently confirmed 'flags delete own', 'admin delete any flag', 'flag-photos owner delete', and 'flag-photos admin delete' all live (authorization.flagsPolicies / storage.objectPolicies) — this was previously only a documented deployedAlternative, now exercised.

callSites.name: flags
callSites.note: Snapshot read (id, user_id, photo_url, photo_object_key) before any delete, so media cleanup knows its exact target set. flags SELECT is 'flags readable by authenticated' (true) — always live.

callSites.name: flag_photos
callSites.note: Snapshot read of gallery photo url/object_key before the row (and its ON DELETE CASCADE flag_photos rows) are gone. flag_photos SELECT is 'flag_photos: authenticated read' (true) — always live.

callSites.name: flags
callSites.note: DELETE ... RETURNING id. Authorization is 'flags delete own' (auth.uid() = user_id) OR 'admin delete any flag' (users.is_admin) — both confirmed live in deployed-contract.v1.json authorization.flagsPolicies. Zero returned rows (RLS refusal or already-gone) throws FlagDeleteRefusedError; this client never infers owner/admin privilege itself.
